// Jwt:Key: Do not commit a real signing key here. Set it via `dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "<a long random secret>"`, or the PETCARE_JWT_KEY environment variable. No hardcoded fallback is used.
// AgenticService: Internal advisory AI service (agentic-service/). BaseUrl e.g. http://localhost:8000. InternalKey is the shared secret sent as X-Internal-Key — set it via `dotnet user-secrets set "AgenticService:InternalKey" "<secret>"` or the PETCARE_AGENTIC_INTERNAL_KEY environment variable; never commit it.
